title: Trigonometric and Elliptic R-Matrices from Three-Dimensional WZW Models
exact_target: Extend the three-dimensional WZW construction to broader differential-form choices producing trigonometric or elliptic R-matrices.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath, record 30004880 (OWR-8415354-006). Catalogue curation under CC BY 4.0; definitions and English exposition added locally.
Mini-Workshop: Three Facets of R-Matrices (2021), Oberwolfach Reports, DOI 10.4171/owr/2021/51, pp. 2791--2825. Original report and mathematical context.

status_qualification: The source asks for an extension of its particular construction. It does not assert that every arbitrary differential form produces an integrable theory.
